data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Murahiban means ‘The Beloved One’. This name is derived from the root word ‘R-H-B’, which denotes love and affection. It is often used for a girl who is cherished, adored, and holds a special place in the hearts of her family. The name Murahiban carries the meaning “The Beloved One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murahiban usually hope their child will grow to embody the beloved one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
